name: Hello Terminal

cmd: echo 'Hello from a V2Mac mini VM.'; echo "Exit: $(cat /run/v2mac/exit.json 2>/dev/null)"; echo "Time zone: ${TZ:-unknown}"; exec bash -l

changelog: Built on the base of V2Mac Sandbox 1.0.0: downloads only what it adds.
securityNotes: Asks for ssh-agent so SSH through the mini VM's exit can use your Mac's keys.
